title: Never learning to read music
summary: He took one lesson, was told his ear was too good, and feared reading after Henny died.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear

blocks.x: Tell me, I'm not trying to embarrass you or anything, but did you ever learn to read any at all much?

No, I never took a lesson. I took one lesson from Jerry Schrimmer. He says, that's Gene Caffarelli's stepfather. He used to run the con company. He says, your ear's too good. He says, you can't learn to read music. You heard by hearsay. I took one lesson. And my brother Henny taught himself how to read. And after he learned how to read, he passed away. Yeah. That's why I was superstitious. I was afraid to learn how to read.
I've been doing better than a lot of guys that's reading.
I have no complaints. You can play anything. It's remarkable.
I mean, that... I do have a good ear. That's not egotism. That's right. It's just a fact.
That's a God gift. Anybody that's ever heard you say that. Would you advise young kids, if they have a lot of talent, not to bother to read? Just pick it up and use their...
